articles.title_en: Robust Estimation and Inference in Panels with Interactive Fixed Effects
articles.title_cn: 具有交互固定效应的面板数据中的稳健估计与推断
articles.abstract_en: We consider estimation and inference for a regression coefficient in panels with interactive fixed effects (i.e., a factor structure). We show that previously developed estimators and confidence intervals (CIs) are heavily biased and size distorted when some of the factors are weak. Combining the theory of minimax linear estimation with a nuclear norm bound on the error of an initial estimate of the interactive effects, we propose estimators with improved rates of convergence and uniformly valid CIs allowing for weak factors. Our method substantially outperforms conventional approaches when factors are weak, with little cost to estimation error when factors are strong.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑具有交互固定效应（即因子结构）的面板数据中回归系数的估计与推断。我们表明，当某些因子较弱时，先前开发的估计量和置信区间（CIs）存在严重偏差和尺寸扭曲。结合极小极大线性估计理论与交互效应初始估计误差的核范数界，我们提出了具有改进收敛速度和允许弱因子的统一有效置信区间的估计量。当因子较弱时，我们的方法显著优于传统方法，而当因子较强时，对估计误差的代价很小。

articles.title_en: Do Mergers and Acquisitions Improve Efficiency? Evidence from Power Plants
articles.title_cn: 并购是否提高了效率？来自发电厂的证据
articles.abstract_en: We analyze acquisitions in US power plants by using rich data on hourly productivity and thousands of ownership changes. We find a 2% average increase in efficiency for acquired plants, beginning 5 months after acquisition. Efficiency gains rise to 5% under direct ownership changes, with no significant change when only parent ownership changes. Investigating the mechanisms, three-quarters of the efficiency gain is attributed to increased productive efficiency, while the rest comes from dynamic efficiency through changes in production allocation. Our evidence suggests that high-productivity firms buy underperforming assets from low-productivity firms and make them as productive as their existing assets through operational improvements.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用每小时生产率和数千次所有权变更的丰富数据，分析了美国发电厂的收购行为。我们发现，被收购工厂的效率平均提高了2%，这一提高始于收购后5个月。在直接所有权变更的情况下，效率提升可达5%，而仅母公司所有权变更时则无显著变化。通过研究其机制，效率提升的四分之三归因于生产效率的提高，其余部分则来自通过生产分配变化实现的动态效率。我们的证据表明，高生产率企业从低生产率企业手中收购表现不佳的资产，并通过运营改进使其达到与现有资产相当的生产率水平。

articles.title_en: Sleep: Educational Impact and Habit Formation
articles.title_cn: 睡眠：教育影响与习惯形成
articles.abstract_en: In a field experiment among US university students, incentives for sleep increase both sleep and academic performance. Our primary intervention pairs bedtime reminders with morning feedback and immediate rewards for sleeping at least 7 hours on weeknights. The intervention raises the share of weeknights with 7+ hours of sleep by 26% and average sleep by 19 minutes during a 4-week treatment period, with posttreatment effects of 8 minutes. Immediate incentives outperform both delayed incentives and reminders/feedback alone during treatment but have no distinguishable impacts posttreatment. The primary intervention improves average semester course performance by 0.075–0.089 grade points, a 0.10–0.11 standard deviation increase. Our results demonstrate that incentives targeting sleep can be a cost-effective approach to improve educational outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 在一项针对美国大学生的实地实验中，睡眠激励措施同时增加了睡眠时间和学业表现。我们的主要干预措施将就寝提醒与晨间反馈以及在工作日晚间至少睡眠7小时的即时奖励相结合。该干预措施将工作日晚间睡眠达到7小时及以上的比例提高了26%，在4周的治疗期内平均睡眠时间增加了19分钟，治疗后效应为8分钟。即时激励在治疗期间优于延迟激励以及仅提醒/反馈，但在治疗后没有显著差异。主要干预措施将学期平均课程成绩提高了0.075-0.089个绩点，即0.10-0.11个标准差的增加。我们的结果表明，针对睡眠的激励措施可以成为改善教育成果的一种成本有效的方法。

articles.title_en: Making a Swap: Network Formation with Increasing Marginal Costs
articles.title_cn: 进行交换：边际成本递增下的网络形成
articles.abstract_en: I propose a general theory of strategic network formation based on increasing marginal linking costs and vertical heterogeneity among the players. In the spirit of revealed preference, I describe the entire set of graphs that can be stable, without making any parametric assumptions about players’ preferences. Stable graphs feature assortativity and clustering, and I highlight conditions that lead to hierarchies and cliquish behavior. Extensions shed light on which findings are robust and which are more fragile. Collectively, these results map interpretable properties of preferences to particular network structures and furnish new tools to study strategic network formation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我提出了一种基于递增的边际连接成本和参与者之间垂直异质性的战略网络形成的通用理论。本着显示性偏好的精神，我描述了可能稳定的整个图集，而不对参与者的偏好做任何参数假设。稳定图具有同配性和聚类性，我强调了导致层级和小团体行为的条件。扩展部分揭示了哪些发现是稳健的，哪些更为脆弱。总的来说，这些结果将偏好的可解释属性映射到特定的网络结构，并为研究战略网络形成提供了新工具。

articles.abstract_en: We study optimal service allocation through queues when agents have homogeneous preferences and must be incentivized to enter and remain in the queue. The designer controls entry, exit, service priority, and information about queue priorities. Under a mild regularity condition, the optimal mechanism admits agents only up to a cutoff queue length, never removes admitted agents, serves them according to a first-come, first-served (FCFS) rule, and provides no information beyond recommendations. FCFS is also necessary for optimality in a rich domain. The result identifies a new role for queue disciplines in regulating agents’ beliefs and dynamic incentives, and uncovers a hitherto unrecognized virtue of FCFS in this regard.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了当代理人具有同质偏好且必须被激励进入并留在队列中时，通过队列进行最优服务分配的问题。设计者控制进入、退出、服务优先级以及关于队列优先级的信息。在一个温和的正则性条件下，最优机制仅允许代理人进入直到一个截止队列长度，从不移除已接纳的代理人，按照先到先服务（FCFS）规则为他们服务，并且除了建议外不提供任何信息。FCFS在一个丰富域中也是最优性的必要条件。该结果确定了队列规则在调节代理人信念和动态激励方面的新作用，并揭示了FCFS在这方面迄今未被认识到的优点。

articles.title_en: Exchange Rates and Asset Prices in a Global Demand System
articles.title_cn: 全球需求体系中的汇率与资产价格
articles.abstract_en: We develop an asset demand system to analyze the equilibrium relation between international portfolio holdings and flows, exchange rates, and asset prices across all countries. We introduce a nested logit model of asset demand, for which we develop a new identification strategy by instrumental variables. Averaged across years and issuer countries, the demand elasticities are 27.9 for short-term debt, 3.2 for long-term debt, and 1.2 for equity. These demand elasticities are empirical targets for international macro models that feature inelastic demand to resolve long-standing puzzles in international finance. We use the estimated demand system to decompose the variation in exchange rates and asset prices into portfolio flows and shifts in asset demand to interpret economic events such as the European sovereign debt crisis and to estimate the convenience yields on US assets. In units of annual expected returns, the convenience yield is 1.41% on the US dollar, 2.71% on US long-term debt, and 0.50% on US equity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个资产需求体系，以分析国际投资组合持有与流动、汇率以及各国资产价格之间的均衡关系。我们引入了资产需求的嵌套logit模型，并为此开发了一种新的工具变量识别策略。跨年份和发行国平均来看，短期债务的需求弹性为27.9，长期债务为3.2，股权为1.2。这些需求弹性是国际宏观模型中需求无弹性的实证目标，用以解决国际金融中长期存在的难题。我们利用估计的需求体系将汇率和资产价格的变动分解为投资组合流动和资产需求变动，以解读欧洲主权债务危机等经济事件，并估计美国资产的便利收益。以年度预期收益为单位，美元的便利收益为1.41%，美国长期债务为2.71%，美国股权为0.50%。

articles.title_cn: 可扩展的需求与加成率
articles.abstract_en: We study changes in markups across 70 product markets from 2006 to 2018. A growing literature has documented rising markups using a production function approach. We instead estimate demand and invert firms’ first-order pricing conditions to infer markups. To make the method scalable, we propose estimating nested logit demand models using household panel data to automate the assignment of products to nests. We find an overall upward trend in markups, with considerable heterogeneity across and within product markets. These increases are primarily driven by changes in firms’ marginal costs and households’ price sensitivity instead of changes in firm ownership.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了从2006到2018期间70个产品市场中的加成率变化。越来越多的文献通过生产函数方法记录了加成率的上升。我们转而估计需求并反转企业的一阶定价条件来推断加成率。为使该方法具有可扩展性，我们提出使用家庭面板数据估计嵌套logit需求模型，以自动将产品分配到各巢中。我们发现加成率总体呈上升趋势，且在不同产品市场内部及之间存在相当大的异质性。这些增长主要由企业边际成本和家庭价格敏感性的变化驱动，而非企业所有权变化所致。

articles.title_cn: 布莱克威尔单调更新规则
articles.abstract_en: An updating rule specifies how an agent reacts to information. It is Blackwell monotone if more information is always better for an agent in any decision problem and strictly Blackwell monotone if, in addition, every strict information improvement is strictly better in some decision problem. Bayes’s law is strictly Blackwell monotone. Within a broad class of updating rules—those that distort Bayesian posteriors in a signal-independent manner—it is the only strictly Blackwell-monotone updating rule. If decisions are evaluated nonpaternalistically (according to an agent’s beliefs), the Blackwell-monotone updating rules are affine distortions of Bayesian posteriors.
articles.abstract_cn: 更新规则规定了代理人如何对信息做出反应。如果信息在任何决策问题中对代理人总是更好，则该规则是布莱克威尔单调的；如果此外，在某个决策问题中，每一次严格的信息改进都严格更好，则该规则是严格布莱克威尔单调的。贝叶斯定律是严格布莱克威尔单调的。在一大类更新规则中——那些以信号无关的方式扭曲贝叶斯后验的规则——它是唯一严格布莱克威尔单调的更新规则。如果决策以非家长式的方式（根据代理人的信念）进行评估，则布莱克威尔单调更新规则是贝叶斯后验的仿射扭曲。
